h_wording.H410: Very toxic to aquatic life with long lasting effects

presence.note: A UVB filter the maker adds.

why_it_matters.text: A UVB filter: salicylic acid joined to a ring alcohol, 3,3,5-trimethylcyclohexanol. It absorbs UVB near 306 nm, and as an oily liquid it also dissolves powdery filters such as avobenzone.

approval.product: OTC Monograph M020, Sunscreen Drug Products for Over-the-Counter Human Use
approval.basis: FDA OTC monograph. M020.10(g), "Homosalate up to 15 percent", in M020 as amended by Final Administrative Order OTC000039 (issued 2026-06-10, corrected 2026-08-10); the later order OTC000008-1 (Federal Register 2026-09-11) removed only aminobenzoic acid and trolamine salicylate. Checked 2026-11-14.

description: A UVB filter: salicylic acid joined to a ring alcohol, 3,3,5-trimethylcyclohexanol. It absorbs UVB near 306 nm, and as an oily liquid it also dissolves powdery filters such as avobenzone.

parts.label: The ester group
parts.sentence: A C=O joined through an oxygen to another carbon, the link an acid and an alcohol make when they combine. Water can split it back into the two.

parts.label: The phenol group
parts.sentence: An O-H fixed directly to a benzene ring. The ring makes that hydrogen easier to give up than an ordinary alcohol's, which is why many phenols act as antioxidants.

parts.label: The benzene ring
parts.sentence: Six carbons in a flat hexagon, sharing their electrons evenly around the ring. It is stable, flat and oily, and it stacks readily against other flat rings.
